title: Add security-scan as Step 4.5 in monitor-codebase
prompt:
Add a new Step 4.5 to the monitor-codebase shell script (run.sh) that
runs the security-scan skill on the project being scanned.

Insert between Step 4 (quality checks) and Step 5 (autofix docstrings).

The security-scan skill is at .pi/skills/security-scan/run.sh and
supports: scan (all), sast, deps, secrets.

For the nightly scan, run the full scan with JSON output:
  run_skill_timed security-scan scan "$project_path" --format json > "$sec_file"

Store the output to $ARTIFACTS_DIR/${project_name}_security.json

Also update the Step 9 aggregate report to include security findings count.
Parse the JSON for counts: secrets_found, vulnerable_deps, sast_findings.

Add these to the summary variables used in the memory learn step.
